title: FLIGHT 112 Screenplay Script by David S. Cass & Stephen Lodge - VTG Movie Script
descriptionText:
This is an original screenplay copy titled “FLIGHT 112”, written by David S. Cass and Stephen Lodge. The script is bound with traditional brass brads and features the title on the cover and handwritten title notation on the script edge/spine.
This appears to be a working or production copy, and may have been used for review or revision purposes. The script begins with an introductory crawl and continues into a detailed scene breakdown and dialogue.
Details:
Title: FLIGHT 112
Writers: David S. Cass & Stephen Lodge
Format: Printed bound screenplay
Approximate length: ~100+ pages (standard screenplay formatting)
Binding: Brass brads
Likely late 20th century production / concept era
Contact information for the writer(s) appears on title page (period-correct formatting and contact type)
This is a great item for:
Film & screenplay collectors
Fans of vintage aviation thrillers
Screenwriters and students of script format
Memorabilia & archival collection
Condition
Very Good physical condition overall. Pages are clean and readable. Cover shows some light handling wear, edge wear, and slight age toning. No major markings inside beyond natural use. Please review all photos to assess condition for yourself.
